{{Quote|You know, when I was working me way to the massive fortune I now have, people were always trying to hold me back. But they were the losers. I'm a winner. That's why I'm the industrial tubing king of Coronet.|Frye Troeman|<ref name="SWG:SOtGS" />}}
'''Frye Troeman''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] businessman who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's a local businessman who owes me some money for services I performed for him a while back. He refuses to pay. Could you go talk to him and collect my payment from him?''"<br />"''I'd be happy to help.''"<br />"''Thank you. His name's Frye Troeman. He's not pleasant.|A gadget specialist and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SOtGS" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he operated out of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:SOtGS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Troeman owned some money to a gadget specialist for services performed on a malfunctioning terminal but refused to pay. As the gadget specialist used to work with the [[Corellian Security Force]], the gadget specialist once requested a spacer working with CorSec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] to collect the payment from Troeman. The businessman was reluctant but apparently accepted to pay. In fact, he sent his henchmen to assassinate the spacer. Nevertheless, the spacer managed to kill all the assassins. When the spacer returned to him, Frye Troeman was forced to pay off his debt.<ref name="SWG:SOtGS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frye Troeman was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SOtGS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Frye Troeman was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:SOtGS" /> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:SOtGS" />
